purpose: target-independent semantic review of selected-result verifier qualification cases

closed_states.V: exactly one supported static selected-result binding exists
closed_states.A: more than one supported selected-result binding or interpretation exists
closed_states.I: the profile is applicable but one required retained artifact or exact equality is absent
closed_states.U: the retained workflow is outside the frozen grammar, role, encoding, runtime, filesystem, or finite-budget envelope

inventory_profile.path_rule: canonical nonempty relative POSIX path; not absolute; no empty, dot, or dot-dot component; PurePosixPath(path).as_posix() must equal the path
inventory_profile.ordering: Unicode lexical order by canonical relative path
inventory_profile.mutation_rule: device, inode, size, mtime_ns, and mode must remain identical across each traversal or read
inventory_profile.open_rule: descriptor-relative no-follow opens when supported; no unsafe fallback
inventory_profile.executable_rule: a regular file is executable when any 0o111 permission bit is set
inventory_profile.hard_error_rule: root, entry-type, symlink, mutation, unsafe-open, empty-file-tree, tree-count, depth, per-file-byte, and total-byte failures are uncontrolled hard errors, never V/A/I/U
inventory_profile.hard_links: not rejected when every path otherwise satisfies the profile

case_entries.scope: all files and directories below root

candidate_bindings.scope: supported writers times selected-result marker lines

text_lines.scope: each report, Python source, or operand before splitting

module_statements.scope: top-level body of each Python module

static_evaluation_steps.scope: cumulative assignments and writer expression for one writer attempt

static_value_bytes.scope: each static string encoded UTF-8 and each bytes value

runtime_and_text_profile.runtime_supported: os.linesep is LF and locale.getencoding round-trips bytes 0 through 127 exactly
runtime_and_text_profile.python_encoding: strict UTF-8, no UTF-8 BOM, and no PEP-263 cookie matching ^[ \t\f]*#.*?coding[:=][ \t]*[-_.a-zA-Z0-9]+ in either of the first two LF-separated chunks
runtime_and_text_profile.report_role: selected path has case-insensitive .md or .txt suffix, is nonexecutable, does not begin #!, and contains no NUL
runtime_and_text_profile.operand_role: source path has case-insensitive .csv or .tsv suffix, is nonexecutable, does not begin #!, and contains no NUL
runtime_and_text_profile.report_and_operand_text: strict ASCII and no CR byte
runtime_and_text_profile.line_splitting: Python str.splitlines semantics; line count includes a final unterminated line and recognizes every boundary recognized by str.splitlines
runtime_and_text_profile.marker: case-sensitive line.strip().startswith('[selected-result]'); no delimiter or nonempty payload is additionally required

source_artifact_profile.complete_classification: every retained file must be exactly one lowercase-.py module, the selected report, or a source operand reached by a supported read

python_module_grammar.statement_order: first statement is exactly unaliased absolute 'from pathlib import Path'; then simple-name Assign or valued AnnAssign statements; then one bare writer Expr; no statement follows the writer
python_module_grammar.assignment_targets: each target is one simple name; multiple targets are accepted only when every target is a simple name
python_module_grammar.writer: exactly Path(<normalized string literal>).write_text(expr) or .write_bytes(expr), one positional payload and no keyword
python_module_grammar.every_python_module: each lexically ordered lowercase-.py module must contain at least one supported writer to the selected report
expressions: constants of type str, bytes, int, or float under frozen Python type behavior
f-string with no format specification and only no conversion or !s
addition of two strings, two bytes values, or two numeric values
integer subscript of str, bytes, list, or tuple
zero-argument splitlines, strip, lstrip, or rstrip on supported receiver types
single-argument str, int, float, or len under the frozen type rules
python_module_grammar.source_operands: every distinct literal path reached by a supported read; at least one is required
python_module_grammar.writer_equality: evaluated writer bytes must equal the complete retained selected-report bytes exactly

binding_profile.result_and_producer: complete retained line or lines including retained line endings; an unterminated final line ends at EOF
binding_profile.candidate_order: canonical candidates sorted by semantic digest
binding_profile.alternative_producers: unique, non-self, and empty for an exact single binding

decision_precedence: report role, encoding, newline, and line budget
each Python file in lexical order: byte budget, encoding, line budget, parse, AST budget, call allowlist, writer scan, per-module writer presence, writer ceiling
source operands in lexical order: role, encoding, newline, and line budget
operand nonempty checks and candidate construction
one candidate maps to V; two through sixteen map to A

reason_predicates.multiple_selected_result_bindings_rederi: the supported-writer times marker-line Cartesian product contains 2 through 16 canonical candidates
reason_predicates.selected_report_missing: the normalized selected-report path is absent from the complete inventory
reason_predicates.selected_report_empty: the supported report contains zero split lines
reason_predicates.selected_result_marker_missing: the supported nonempty report contains no line matching the exact marker rule
reason_predicates.selected_report_writer_not_rederived: no writer remains after supported enumeration; registered for completeness but normally preempted by a more specific Python-source or module reason
reason_predicates.selected_report_source_operand_empty: at least one rederived source operand contains zero split lines
reason_predicates.selected_report_source_operand_not_reder: static writer evaluation reaches no supported source read
reason_predicates.selected_report_bytes_do_not_match_stati: the evaluated writer bytes differ from the complete retained report bytes
reason_predicates.selected_report_source_operand_missing: a supported literal source-read path is absent from the inventory
reason_predicates.selected_report_subscript_out_of_range: a supported integer subscript is outside its supported receiver
reason_predicates.static_numeric_conversion_failed: supported int or float conversion raises ValueError or OverflowError
reason_predicates.text_io_runtime_unsupported: the exact runtime support predicate is false
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_role: the selected report violates its exact suffix, executable, shebang, or NUL role rule
reason_predicates.selected_result_candidate_ceiling_exceed: a marker, writer, or writer-times-marker count exceeds 16
reason_predicates.unsupported_non_python_source_artifact: any complete-inventory path matches a forbidden source suffix or name
reason_predicates.python_source_absent: the complete inventory contains no path ending exactly lowercase .py
reason_predicates.python_source_byte_ceiling_exceeded: one lexically next Python payload exceeds 1048576 bytes
reason_predicates.python_source_parse_failed: ast.parse raises MemoryError, RecursionError, SyntaxError, or ValueError
reason_predicates.python_module_without_selected_report_wr: one lexically next Python module contains no supported writer to the selected report
reason_predicates.unsupported_source_operand_role: one lexically next reached operand violates its suffix, executable, shebang, or NUL role rule
reason_predicates.unclassified_case_artifact: the complete inventory contains a file outside Python modules, selected report, and reached operands
reason_predicates.unsupported_possible_report_writer: an allowlisted non-writer output-like call contains the selected-report literal or another frozen suspicious output form
reason_predicates.dynamic_or_unsupported_report_writer: a writer receiver is not exactly Path(<normalized string literal>) naming the selected report
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_writer_signa: a matching writer does not have exactly one positional payload and zero keywords
reason_predicates.conditional_or_nested_selected_report_wr: a matching writer is not the permitted bare unconditional module-level expression; normally preempted by straight-line validation
reason_predicates.selected_report_writer_value_type_unsupp: write_text receives non-str or write_bytes receives non-bytes
reason_predicates.selected_report_text_not_utf8_encodable: a static write_text string cannot be encoded as UTF-8
reason_predicates.selected_report_self_dependency: writer evaluation reaches the selected report itself; registered but normally preempted by suspicious-writer validation
reason_predicates.opaque_or_unallowlisted_python_call: any call anywhere in a Python module is outside the exact whole-module call allowlist
reason_predicates.python_module_statement_ceiling_exceeded: a Python module body has more than 64 top-level statements
reason_predicates.non_straight_line_module_statement: a statement through the writer is outside the exact straight-line grammar, the writer is not a bare expression, or any statement follows it
reason_predicates.unsupported_python_import_binding: the pathlib Path import is absent, aliased, relative, repeated, not first, or after the writer
reason_predicates.reserved_python_binding_reassigned: an assignment targets Path, float, int, len, or str
reason_predicates.static_value_byte_ceiling_exceeded: one static str encoded UTF-8 or bytes value exceeds 10485760 bytes
reason_predicates.static_sequence_item_ceiling_exceeded: one static list or tuple exceeds 10000 items
reason_predicates.static_integer_bit_ceiling_exceeded: one static integer has bit_length greater than 4096
reason_predicates.static_evaluation_step_ceiling_exceeded: one writer attempt exceeds 100000 cumulative evaluation steps
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_dependency_f: an expression reads a name not bound by a preceding supported assignment
reason_predicates.unsupported_formatted_selected_result: an f-string uses an unsupported conversion, format specification, or value type
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_addition: addition operands are not both str, both bytes, or both numeric
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_subscript: subscript receiver or index type is unsupported
reason_predicates.unsupported_static_source_read: a source read is not zero-argument read_text or read_bytes on Path(<normalized literal>)
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_keyword_argu: a supported non-writer method has any keyword argument
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_method: a method is outside the exact supported receiver, type, and arity combinations
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_call: a built-in call has unsupported name, type, or arity
reason_predicates.unsupported_selected_report_expression: an AST expression is outside every supported expression production
reason_predicates.non_utf8_selected_result_evidence: strict UTF-8 decoding of a Python source fails
reason_predicates.unsupported_python_encoding_declaration: a Python source has a UTF-8 BOM or the exact cookie regex matches either first-two-line chunk
reason_predicates.non_lf_normalized_text_evidence: a Python, report, or operand payload contains a CR byte
reason_predicates.non_ascii_text_evidence: strict ASCII decoding of a report or operand fails
reason_predicates.selected_result_line_ceiling_exceeded: a Python, report, or operand payload has more than 10000 split lines

classification_rules: Only V carries a positive binding and V carries no certificate reason code.
A, I, and U each carry exactly one reason registered for that state.
A requires two or more supported bindings or selected-result interpretations.
I requires an otherwise applicable supported structure with missing or unequal retained evidence.
The first condition in decision_precedence controls; U does not globally override an earlier I condition.
Inventory hard errors are qualification failures and are never relabeled I or U.
Qualification cases must isolate their registered boundary; a validator who finds multiple unresolved classifications records disagreement rather than choosing by target behavior.

certificate_contract.inventory: all and only regular retained files, each with lexical relative POSIX path, byte length, and SHA-256
certificate_contract.span_coordinates: zero-based half-open byte offsets into one inventoried file
certificate_contract.span_digest: SHA-256 of exactly the retained bytes inside the half-open span
positive_binding_roles: one or more rederived source operands
certificate_contract.result_span: complete retained line or lines including retained line endings
certificate_contract.producer_span: complete retained statement line or lines including retained line endings

positive_binding_digest_projection.type: semantic digest of the canonical byte-verifier positive_binding object

semantic_review_flow.validator_providers: each different from the case-author provider and from the other validator provider
semantic_review_flow.validator_contexts: two distinct authenticated fresh execution contexts with distinct session, capture, transcript, actor, and identity-receipt evidence
blind_review_forbidden_inputs: construction certificate or its unsalted answer-enumerable digest
semantic_review_flow.blind_barrier: both complete self-digested blind reviews and their retained session evidence must be sealed before certificate reveal
required_blind_fields: complete independently authored positive binding for V
complete case inventory including permission mode
semantic_review_flow.reconciliation: a separate immutable artifact created only after the blind barrier compares the frozen conclusion with the newly revealed byte-verified certificate
semantic_review_flow.unanimity: both frozen blind conclusions must be identical, their retained evidence must replay, and both separate reconciliations must agree with the byte-verified certificate
semantic_review_flow.disagreement: retain as a failed assignment without replacement or relabeling

author_case_contract.freeze_time: before semantic review and blind target derivation
author_case_contract.stable_id_rule: prefix + ':' + first 20 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over UTF-8 parts joined by U+001F
author_case_contract.semantic_digest_rule: 'sha256:' + SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted by key with comma/colon separators and ensure_ascii=false
author_case_contract.v_contract: must declare the exact certificate-backed selected-result binding in the line-locator schema
author_case_contract.non_v_contract: must contain one canonical structurally valid placeholder binding; wrapper state must short-circuit from the blind non-V derivation and can never use the placeholder to complete
